_doc: ENV-PATHS-1110 exemptions for scripts/check_env_paths.py. Key: file + function + env + sink + sha256 of the enclosing function. reason is one of selector, denied-name, db-url-not-file, test-only-runner-set, pending-decision. reviewer must be an independent Verifier or owner id (not the implementer); PENDING-* is counted as UNREVIEWED in the checker summary. This file's sha256 is pinned in tests/test_env_paths_guard.py.

exemptions.note: VERA_FULLDOC_BUNDLE_DIR (config bundle_dir_env) names a bundle directory; manifest and sums are read and then sha256-pinned. Not one of the three planned sites; no allowed root named in the plan. Needs an orchestrator decision: wire safe_path with a named root, or accept on the pin.
